title: progressive compression scheme not tractable for high dimensions
description: The proposed progressive lossy compression interpretation relies on minimal random coding, which is not tractable for high-dimensional data.
canonical_description: progressive lossy compression scheme not tractable for high-dimensional data

evidence.quote: Our lossy compression argument in Section 5 is only a proof of concept, because Algorithms 1 and 2 depend on a procedure such as minimal random coding, which is not tractable for high dimensional data.
